from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import pytest

import llm_router
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.tools import parse_tool_call

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_MULTI_ROUND_TOOL_EXECUTION[revision==1]")
def test_tool_calls_without_registry_returns_public_response_immediately() -> None:
    executor = __import__(
        "llm_router._internal.runtime.executor",
        fromlist=["_advance_tool_result"],
    )
    _advance_tool_result = executor._advance_tool_result
    ProviderRequest = executor.ProviderRequest
    ProviderResult = executor.ProviderResult
    _ExecutionPlan = executor._ExecutionPlan
    _ExecutionLoopState = executor._ExecutionLoopState

    call = parse_tool_call(
        {
            "id": "call_add_1",
            "type": "function",
            "function": {"name": "add", "arguments": '{"a": 40, "b": 44}'},
        }
    )
    tool_calls = (call,)
    existing_trace = ("trace_step_1",)

    tool_state_cls = getattr(
        executor, "_ToolLoopState", getattr(executor, "_ToolState", None)
    )
    if tool_state_cls is not None:
        tool_state = tool_state_cls(steps=existing_trace)
    else:
        tool_state = dataclasses.make_dataclass(
            "_SimpleToolState", [("steps", tuple)]
        )(steps=existing_trace)

    provider_request = ProviderRequest(
        provider="openai",
        model="gpt-4o",
        messages=(),
    )
    plan = _ExecutionPlan(
        tool_registry=None,
        tool_choice="auto",
    )
    state = _ExecutionLoopState(
        messages=(),
        tool_state=tool_state,
        tool_choice="auto",
    )
    result = ProviderResult(
        output_text="",
        tool_calls=tool_calls,
        token_count=84,
    )

    step = _advance_tool_result(
        provider_request=provider_request,
        plan=plan,
        state=state,
        result=result,
    )

    assert step is not None
    assert step.response is not None
    assert step.response.tool_calls == tool_calls
    assert step.response.tool_trace == existing_trace
